title: FY27 BROOKLYN NORTH INDUSTRIAL BUSINESS ZONE SERVICES
agency_path: City of New York > Small Business Services
description_text:
The NYC Department of Small Business Services is entering into a Negotiated Acquisition Extension Contract with Evergreen Inc.  Your North Brooklyn Business Exchange, to continue Industrial Business Zone services in Northern Brooklyn to reinforce the Citys efforts to support the industrial and manufacturing sector by responding to current and evolving needs while providing the conditions and resources to enable the sector to further grow and advance. The contract term will be from 7/1/2026 to 6/30/2027, in the amount of $170,000.00. EPIN: 80127N0003.
 

The negotiated acquisition extension will allow the agency adequate time to complete negotiations and contract for the new solicitation for this program and enable the current IBSP provider to continue to deliver a suite of business services.

Vendors interested in responding to this or other future solicitations for these types of services should contact Dolly Del Rosario at procurementhelpdesk@sbs.nyc.gov
